operations.name: J. Tony Serra

expected.charges: Willful failure to pay federal income taxes — $44,000 owed
expected.sentence:
10 months federal prison (served 9 months in federal facility + 1 month halfway house)

Charges as recorded: Willful failure to pay federal income taxes — $44,000 owed for tax years 1998–1999; Serra stated his refusal was principled political protest against U.S. military spending

updates.plead: Guilty on April 5, 2005 to two counts of willful failure to pay federal income taxes
updates.prosecutor: Charles A. O’Reilly; Blake D. Stamm

operations.source: Primary DOJ individual plea report: https://www.justice.gov/archive/opa/pr/2005/April/05_tax_165.htm . Names plea date, counts and actual trial prosecutors; sentencing and self-surrender dates remain distinct.

operations.name: Martin Sostre

expected.charges: Political Prosecution False Statements Drug charges

updates.sentence: Originally consecutive terms of 25–30 years for heroin sale, 5–10 years for the altercation with arresting officers, one year for possession, and 30 days for contempt. The Appellate Division modified the terms to run concurrently in 1973.
updates.convicted: Yes; convicted in New York state court on March 18, 1968

operations.source: Primary United States ex rel. Sostre v. Festa, 513 F.2d 1313: https://law.justia.com/cases/federal/appellate-courts/F2/513/1313/81347/ . Opinion records conviction date; concurrence details original component terms and footnote 3 records concurrent modification. Sentence history distinguished from actual time served; existing release preserved.
